author: PC Gamer
text:
GTA 6's NPCs have about 600,000 animations, as well as personality traits that take 'demographic and professional' variables into account
"Who's going to be aggressive? … How many are going to test me?"

author: PC Gamer
text:
'I feel like we've built a pyramid on Everest' says Rockstar of GTA 6 meeting impossible expectations
"We've not compromised on the scale, the detail, the interactivity, the story, the open world."

author: PC Gamer
text:
GTA 6's map is almost as big as Rockstar's last 3 games combined, contains 'an order of magnitude more interiors'
"You can go anywhere, any random location, and so many people have thought about that location," says co-studio head Aaron Garbut.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Can you name the horror games these deeply unpleasant bathrooms are from?
Bring holy water and Clorox wipes

author: PC Gamer
text:
Epic Games chief Tim Sweeney claims 'Valve has held gaming back for years'
Sweeney says locking developers into the "walled garden" of Steamworks is a real problem.

author: PC Gamer
text:
WoW: Forever's update schedule will be 'a little more laid back' than the main MMO
Developers say the plan is to release updates a few times a year to match the MMO's classic spirit.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Witchbrook is delayed again, now set for release in 2027
We finally have a solid launch date, and it's not in 2026 as planned but it's not too far off, either.

author: PC Gamer
text:
One of the best quests in Baldur's Gate 3 is also its scariest, and it doesn't have anything to do with ghosts or vampires
Drowning in consequences.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Valve admits Steam has an AI slop and cloning problem, but says 'we don't want to be gatekeepers telling developers which tools they should or shouldn't use'
Steam Next Fest is being flooded with thousands of low-effort games, while developers are becoming reluctant to share their work for fear of seeing it quickly cloned.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Backrooms director Kane Parsons is currently working on '3 dream projects' while wearing a Valve hoodie—suspicious
I'm calling it now—Half-Life 3 will be a patchwork of YouTube shorts.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Arc Raiders' executive producer was 'a bit skeptical' about adding PvE, but after the successful test the team needs to decide 'what we want to do going forward'
I say just replicate the PvE test for those who want it.

author: PC Gamer
text:
If you love horror but hate actually being scared, I've got the perfect Halloween game for you
It's unsettling and occasionally startling, but still immensely sweet.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Vote now: 8 games remain in our scariest games bracket
Help us determine which game is the scariest game on PC in round 2 of our Halloween tournament.

author: PC Gamer
text:
GTA 6's PS5 install size is so big you could store 3500 copies of Balatro inside
That's a lot of space to ask for in the midst of the memory crisis.

author: PC Gamer
text:
World of Warcraft was meant to have viable levelling gear from professions way back in 2004, but the designers on raids and dungeons 'cheated a little bit'
Getting crafty.

author: PC Gamer
text:
GOG's getting into publishing in its new, post-CD-Projekt life, and it already has games on the way
Good… new games?

author: PC Gamer
text:
Elon Musk says 'robot RAM needs will exceed everything else on Earth' but only assuming we throw all the data centers into space
Humanoid robots will still consume only a sliver of the RAM AI does.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Proton's Black Friday sale is already live: ditch Google with up to 70% off its VPN and 50% off unlimited plan
That's just $2.99 a month for Proton VPN.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Monster Train 2 is getting a new clan, and they're edgy as h̶e̶l̶l heaven
And it's coming to mobile and handheld platforms.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'Yes, we are vibe-coding things': Epic confirms it's using AI tools to code Unreal Engine 6, Fortnite, and more
'We are more concerned about the risks of moving too slowly than we are about AI skepticism.'

author: PC Gamer
text:
Here's the Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown release time for your region
Set sail in the sprawling RPG's first full-fledged DLC.

author: PC Gamer
text:
FF14's new Evolved jobs won't deal a 'huge amount' more damage than their Reborn counterparts, says Koji Fox
"I think it's going to be very negligible."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Project Titan's end 'immediately instilled a culture of humility' in the Overwatch team which has helped them see the last decade through
"Overwatch was born out of the ashes of a previous [game]."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Here's the Phantom Blade Zero release time for your region
Battle through the Wulin's monsters and martial masters.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Rockstar will hold union vote right on top of Grand Theft Auto 6 release
It's going to be a busy November for Rockstar workers.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Messages in certain large public Discord servers will be searchable on the web after December
Discord is attempting to solve the 'this should've been a forum' problem with specially-designated channels whose messages can show up in search engines.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Mass Effect composer Sam Hulick is working on a 're-scored' version of the leaked Mass Effect 5 trailer for N7 Day
Hulick says he wants the trailer to properly represent his "musical vision" for the cancelled Mass Effect game.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Former Halo boss is now in charge of Wizards of the Coast and Hasbro Digital Games
Dan Ayoub joined WotC in 2024 and previously served as the company's SVP of digital games.
